Design, supply, delivery, installation, testing and commissioning of the followings inclusive of all necessary accessories for the complete installation as per drawings and/or specifications:
BMS Workstation & Servers:

Supply and install Operator Workststion (OWS) as per Technical Specification or latest. BMS workstations complete with 30" LCD monitor and all necessary software & hardware for the monitoring of the building. Workstation is to be located in the Control Room on the Ground Floor of the building.
Supply and install table and swivel chair for BMS workstation.
Supply and install UPS for BMS workstation. The UPS shall support 100% load of workstation and backup time shall be no less than 15 minutes.
Supply and install laser printer for report, event and alarm printing.
Supply and install hardware & software to enable BMS to be accessed from any computer on the Intranet or Internet using only Windows Internet Explorer.
Supply and install hardware & software (Server) to complete the BMS system. To ensure sufficient data storage for 3 months. Server shall be located within the BMS/ELV riser on the ground floor

Supply and install in-rack UPS to support 100% load of BMS server. The backup time shall be no less than 15 minutes.
Supply and install core switch necessary for BMS system.
Supply and install firewall for external connections
TOTAL FOR 2.0 BMS WORKSTATION & SERVERS (RM)
BMS Software & Programming:

Supply and install BMS software c/w operating system and GUI customisation works for BMS including Energy Monitoring System, Chiller Plant Optimisation System, Intelligent Light Control System, monitoring of ASRS and Cold Room Systems as well as future Solar Panel System. GUI shall consists of 3D graphics showing real time information.
BMS application software and all license required for the operations of the OWS, NCUs and Controllers.

BMS software shall have historical data recording and reporting, event message, optimum start/stop, run time totalisation, duty cycling, password access control, preventative maintenance and inventory control, energy metering and reporting, water consumption metering and reporting

To ensure all reporting complies with GreenRE Industrial Rating Tool Ver 1.1. E.g (but not limited to):
Chiller Plant Optimisation System
- Data acquisition system shall have a minimum resolution of 16 bit. 
- All data logging shall be sampled and logged at 1 min intervals.  
- Temp sensors to have end-to-end measurement uncertainty not exceeding +/- 0.05C over entire measurement or calibration range
- Calculate real time kW/ton and heat balance in accordance to AHRI 550/590
Water Leak Detection
- From water submeters to calculate and compare incoming water versus consumption to detect water leakage in system
BMS/EPMS:
- Sampling, trending and storage intervals of all equipment data shall be 1 minute per sample.
